original.target_description: Published original verified by title and DOI. PDF p. 5 (printed p. 590), section 3.2, reports multiple omnibus reaction-time effects across tasks, plus nonsignificant group-related tests. The description names emotion-task reaction time but does not identify an omnibus factor, interaction, emotion-specific test, or group comparison.

replication.target_description: Verified replication title and full paper. Study 1 compares 33 adolescent girls with AN and 41 healthy controls; no separate major-depression group. Located reaction times for correct responses analyses on printed p. 946 (PDF p. 4), but the supplied locator does not identify a unique test.
